<span class="line"><span style="color:#d2a8e0">NetClient</span><span style="color:#edf2f8"> client</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1"> =</span><span style="color:#edf2f8"> vertx</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">createNetClient</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#edf2F8FF">config</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">)</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span></code></pre> </div> </div> </div> <div class="sect2"> <h3 id="_using_ha_proxy_protocol"><a class="link" href="#_using_ha_proxy_protocol">Using HA PROXY protocol</a></h3> <div class="paragraph"> <p><a href="https://www.haproxy.org/download/1.8/doc/proxy-protocol.txt">HA PROXY protocol</a> provides a convenient way to safely transport connection information such as a client&#8217;s address across multiple layers of NAT or TCP proxies.</p> </div> <div class="paragraph"> <p>HA PROXY protocol can be enabled by setting the option <code><a href="../../apidocs/io/vertx/core/net/TcpServerConfig.html#setUseProxyProtocol-boolean-">setUseProxyProtocol</a></code> and adding the following dependency in your classpath:</p> </div> <div class="listingblock"> <div class="content"> <pre class="undefined highlight"><code data-lang="xml"><span class="line"><span style="color:#d2a8e1">&#x3C;dependency></span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#d2a8e1">  &#x3C;groupId></span><span style="color:#edf2F8FF">io.netty</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">&#x3C;/groupId></span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#d2a8e1">  &#x3C;artifactId></span><span style="color:#edf2F8FF">netty-codec-haproxy</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">&#x3C;/artifactId></span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#68d391;font-style:italic">  &#x3C;!--&#x3C;version>Should align with netty version that Vert.x uses&#x3C;/version>--></span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#d2a8e1">&#x3C;/dependency></span></span></code></pre> </div> </div> <div class="listingblock"> <div class="content"> <pre class="undefined highlight"><code data-lang="java"><span class="line"><span style="color:#d2a8e0">TcpServerConfig</span><span style="color:#edf2f8"> config</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1"> =</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1"> new</span><span style="color:#f7fafc"> TcpServerConfig</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">().</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">setUseProxyProtocol</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">true</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">)</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#d2a8e0">NetServer</span><span style="color:#edf2f8"> server</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1"> =</span><span style="color:#edf2f8"> vertx</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">createNetServer</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#edf2F8FF">config</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">)</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#edf2f8">server</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">connectHandler</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#edf2F8FF">so </span><span style="color:#d2a8e0">-></span><span style="color:#adb5bd"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#68d391;font-style:italic">  // Print the actual client address provided by the HA proxy protocol instead of the proxy address</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#edf2f8">  System</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#edf2f8">out</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">println</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#edf2f8">so</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">remoteAddress</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">())</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#68d391;font-style:italic">  // Print the address of the proxy</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#edf2f8">  System</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#edf2f8">out</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">println</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#edf2f8">so</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">localAddress</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">())</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">})</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span></code></pre> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> <div class="sect1"> <h2 id="_writing_quic_servers_and_clients"><a class="link" href="#_writing_quic_servers_and_clients">Writing QUIC servers and clients</a></h2> <div class="sectionbody"> <div class="paragraph"> <p>Vert.x allows you to easily write non-blocking QUIC clients and servers.</p> </div> <div class="sect2"> <h3 id="native_quic"><a class="link" href="#native_quic">Configuration of native dependency</a></h3> <div class="paragraph"> <p>The implementation of QUIC relies on Netty and <a href="https://github.com/cloudflare/quiche">QUICHE</a>, a savoury implementation of QUIC which requires native dependencies depending on OS/platform selection.</p> </div> <div class="paragraph"> <p>You need to add the following dependency at <strong>runtime</strong>:</p> </div> <div class="listingblock"> <div class="content"> <pre class="undefined highlight"><code data-lang="xml"><span class="line"><span style="color:#d2a8e1">&#x3C;dependency></span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#d2a8e1">  &#x3C;groupId></span><span style="color:#edf2F8FF">io.netty</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">&#x3C;/groupId></span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#d2a8e1">  &#x3C;artifactId></span><span style="color:#edf2F8FF">netty-codec-native-quic</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">&#x3C;/artifactId></span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#d2a8e1">  &#x3C;classifier></span><span style="color:#edf2F8FF">linux-x86_64</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">&#x3C;/classifier></span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#d2a8e1">&#x3C;/dependency></span></span></code></pre> </div> </div> <div class="paragraph"> <p>OS/platform can be</p> </div> <div class="ulist"> <ul> <li> <p>linux-aarch_64</p> </li> <li> <p>linux-x86_64</p> </li> <li> <p>osx-aarch_64</p> </li> <li> <p>osx-x86_64</p> </li> <li> <p>windows-x86_64</p> </li> </ul> </div> </div> <div class="sect2"> <h3 id="quic_server"><a class="link" href="#quic_server">Creating a QUIC server</a></h3> <div class="paragraph"> <p>The simplest way to create a QUIC server, is as follows:</p> </div> <div class="listingblock"> <div class="content"> <pre class="undefined highlight"><code data-lang="java"><span class="line"><span style="color:#d2a8e0">ServerSSLOptions</span><span style="color:#edf2f8"> sslOptions</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1"> =</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1"> new</span><span style="color:#f7fafc"> ServerSSLOptions</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">()</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">  .</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">setKeyCertOptions</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#d2a8e1">    new</span><span style="color:#f7fafc"> JksOptions</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">().</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#f7fafc">      setPath</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">"</span><span style="color:#90cdf4">/path/to/your/server-keystore.jks</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">"</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">).</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#f7fafc">      setPassword</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">"</span><span style="color:#90cdf4">password-of-your-keystore</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">"</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">  )</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">  .</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">setApplicationLayerProtocols</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#edf2f8">List</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">of</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#edf2F8FF">APPLICATION_PROTOCOL</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">))</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#d2a8e0">QuicServer</span><span style="color:#edf2f8"> server</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1"> =</span><span style="color:#edf2f8"> vertx</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">createQuicServer</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#edf2F8FF">sslOptions</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">)</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span></code></pre> </div> </div> <div class="paragraph"> <p>Unlike TCP, QUIC always requires the usage of TLS and thus requires to provide SSL configuration.</p> </div> <div class="paragraph"> <p>QUIC mandates the usage of application layer protocol negotiation (ALPN) and therefore an application protocol should be set with <code><a href="../../apidocs/io/vertx/core/net/SSLOptions.html#setApplicationLayerProtocols-java.util.List-">setApplicationLayerProtocols</a></code>, without it, no client will be capable of handshaking with this server, the protocol is a simple string that identifies the protocol such as <code>h3</code> for HTTP/3.</p> </div> <div class="admonitionblock note"> <table> <tr> <td class="icon"> <i class="fa icon-note" title="Note"></i> </td> <td class="content"> there is no need to explicitly enable ALPN since it is mandatory </td> </tr> </table> </div> <div class="paragraph"> <p>You can read more about <a href="#server_ssl">SSL server configuration</a>.</p> </div> </div> <div class="sect2"> <h3 id="_configuring_a_quic_server"><a class="link" href="#_configuring_a_quic_server">Configuring a QUIC server</a></h3> <div class="paragraph"> <p>If you don&#8217;t want the default, a server can be configured by passing in a <code><a href="../../apidocs/io/vertx/core/net/QuicServerConfig.html">QuicServerConfig</a></code> instance when creating it:</p> </div> <div class="listingblock"> <div class="content"> <pre class="undefined highlight"><code data-lang="java"><span class="line"><span style="color:#d2a8e0">QuicServerConfig</span><span style="color:#edf2f8"> config</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1"> =</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1"> new</span><span style="color:#f7fafc"> QuicServerConfig</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">()</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">  .</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">setPort</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#90cdf4">4321</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">)</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#d2a8e0">QuicServer</span><span style="color:#edf2f8"> server</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1"> =</span><span style="color:#edf2f8"> vertx</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">createQuicServer</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#edf2F8FF">config</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">,</span><span style="color:#edf2F8FF"> sslOptions</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">)</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span></code></pre> </div> </div> </div> <div class="sect2"> <h3 id="_start_the_server_listening_2"><a class="link" href="#_start_the_server_listening_2">Start the Server Listening</a></h3> <div class="paragraph"> <p>To tell the server to listen for incoming requests you use one of the <code><a href="../../apidocs/io/vertx/core/net/QuicServer.html#listen--">listen</a></code> alternatives.</p> </div> <div class="paragraph"> <p>To tell the server to listen at the host and port as specified in the options:</p> </div> <div class="listingblock"> <div class="content"> <pre class="undefined highlight"><code data-lang="java"><span class="line"><span style="color:#d2a8e0">QuicServer</span><span style="color:#edf2f8"> server</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1"> =</span><span style="color:#edf2f8"> vertx</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">createQuicServer</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#edf2F8FF">sslOptions</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">)</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#edf2f8">server</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">listen</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">()</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span></code></pre> </div> </div> <div class="paragraph"> <p>Or to specify the host and port in the call to listen, ignoring what is configured in the options:</p> </div> <div class="listingblock"> <div class="content"> <pre class="undefined highlight"><code data-lang="java"><span class="line"><span style="color:#d2a8e0">QuicServer</span><span style="color:#edf2f8"> server</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1"> =</span><span style="color:#edf2f8"> vertx</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">createQuicServer</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#edf2F8FF">sslOptions</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">)</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#edf2f8">server</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">listen</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#90cdf4">1234</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">,</span><span style="color:#adb5bd"> "</span><span style="color:#90cdf4">localhost</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">"</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">)</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span></code></pre> </div> </div> <div class="paragraph"> <p>The default host is <code>0.0.0.0</code> which means 'listen on all available addresses' and the default port is <code>0</code>, which is a special value that instructs the server to find a random unused local port and use that.</p> </div> <div class="paragraph"> <p>The actual bind is asynchronous, so the server might not actually be listening until some time <strong>after</strong> the call to listen has returned.</p> </div> <div class="paragraph"> <p>If you want to be notified when the server is actually listening you can provide a handler to the <code>listen</code> call. For example:</p> </div> <div class="listingblock"> <div class="content"> <pre class="undefined highlight"><code data-lang="java"><span class="line"><span style="color:#d2a8e0">QuicServer</span><span style="color:#edf2f8"> server</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1"> =</span><span style="color:#edf2f8"> vertx</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">createQuicServer</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#edf2F8FF">sslOptions</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">)</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#edf2F8FF">server</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">  .</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">listen</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#90cdf4">1234</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">,</span><span style="color:#adb5bd"> "</span><span style="color:#90cdf4">localhost</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">"</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">  .</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">onComplete</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#edf2F8FF">res </span><span style="color:#d2a8e0">-></span><span style="color:#adb5bd"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#d2a8e1">    if</span><span style="color:#adb5bd"> (</span><span style="color:#edf2f8">res</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">succeeded</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">())</span><span style="color:#adb5bd"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#edf2f8">      System</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#edf2f8">out</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">println</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">"</span><span style="color:#90cdf4">Server is now listening!</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">"</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">)</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">    }</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1"> else</span><span style="color:#adb5bd"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#edf2f8">      System</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#edf2f8">out</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">println</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">"</span><span style="color:#90cdf4">Failed to bind!</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">"</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">)</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">    }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">  })</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span></code></pre> </div> </div> </div> <div class="sect2"> <h3 id="_listening_on_a_random_port_2"><a class="link" href="#_listening_on_a_random_port_2">Listening on a random port</a></h3> <div class="paragraph"> <p>If <code>0</code> is used as the listening port, the server will find an unused random port to listen on.</p> </div> <div class="paragraph"> <p>To find out the real port the server is listening on you can use the asynchronous result of <code><a href="../../apidocs/io/vertx/core/net/QuicServer.html#listen--">listen</a></code>.</p> </div> <div class="listingblock"> <div class="content"> <pre class="undefined highlight"><code data-lang="java"><span class="line"><span style="color:#d2a8e0">QuicServer</span><span style="color:#edf2f8"> server</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1"> =</span><span style="color:#edf2f8"> vertx</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">createQuicServer</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#edf2F8FF">sslOptions</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">)</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#edf2F8FF">server</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">  .</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">listen</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#90cdf4">0</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">,</span><span style="color:#adb5bd"> "</span><span style="color:#90cdf4">localhost</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">"</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">  .</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">onComplete</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#edf2F8FF">res </span><span style="color:#d2a8e0">-></span><span style="color:#adb5bd"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#d2a8e1">    if</span><span style="color:#adb5bd"> (</span><span style="color:#edf2f8">res</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">succeeded</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">())</span><span style="color:#adb5bd"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#d2a8e0">      SocketAddress</span><span style="color:#edf2f8"> bindAddr</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1"> =</span><span style="color:#edf2f8"> res</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">result</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">()</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#edf2f8">      System</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#edf2f8">out</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">println</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">"</span><span style="color:#90cdf4">Server is now listening on actual port: </span><span style="color:#adb5bd">"</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1"> +</span><span style="color:#edf2f8"> bindAddr</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">port</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">())</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">    }</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1"> else</span><span style="color:#adb5bd"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#edf2f8">      System</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#edf2f8">out</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">println</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">"</span><span style="color:#90cdf4">Failed to bind!</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">"</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">)</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">    }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">  })</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span></code></pre> </div> </div> </div> <div class="sect2"> <h3 id="_getting_notified_of_incoming_connections_2"><a class="link" href="#_getting_notified_of_incoming_connections_2">Getting notified of incoming connections</a></h3> <div class="paragraph"> <p>To be notified when a connection is made you need to set a <code><a href="../../apidocs/io/vertx/core/net/QuicServer.html#connectHandler-io.vertx.core.Handler-">connectHandler</a></code>:</p> </div> <div class="listingblock"> <div class="content"> <pre class="undefined highlight"><code data-lang="java"><span class="line"><span style="color:#d2a8e0">QuicServer</span><span style="color:#edf2f8"> server</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1"> =</span><span style="color:#edf2f8"> vertx</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">createQuicServer</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#edf2F8FF">sslOptions</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">)</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#edf2f8">server</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">connectHandler</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#edf2F8FF">connection </span><span style="color:#d2a8e0">-></span><span style="color:#adb5bd"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#68d391;font-style:italic">  // Handle the connection in here</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">})</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span></code></pre> </div> </div> </div> <div class="sect2"> <h3 id="_getting_notified_of_incoming_streams"><a class="link" href="#_getting_notified_of_incoming_streams">Getting notified of incoming streams</a></h3> <div class="paragraph"> <p>When a connection is made the handler will be called with an instance of <code><a href="../../apidocs/io/vertx/core/net/QuicConnection.html">QuicConnection</a></code>.</p> </div> <div class="paragraph"> <p>A QUIC connection multiplexes QUIC streams which is what your application actually interacts with.</p> </div> <div class="paragraph"> <p>You can then set a <code><a href="../../apidocs/io/vertx/core/net/QuicConnection.html#streamHandler-io.vertx.core.Handler-">streamHandler</a></code> to handle incoming streams</p> </div> <div class="listingblock"> <div class="content"> <pre class="undefined highlight"><code data-lang="java"><span class="line"><span style="color:#d2a8e0">QuicServer</span><span style="color:#edf2f8"> server</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1"> =</span><span style="color:#edf2f8"> vertx</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">createQuicServer</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#edf2F8FF">sslOptions</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">)</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#edf2f8">server</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">connectHandler</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#edf2F8FF">connection </span><span style="color:#d2a8e0">-></span><span style="color:#adb5bd"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#68d391;font-style:italic">  // Handle the connection in here</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#edf2f8">  connection</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">streamHandler</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#edf2F8FF">stream </span><span style="color:#d2a8e0">-></span><span style="color:#adb5bd"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#68d391;font-style:italic">    // Handle streams here</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">  })</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">})</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span></code></pre> </div> </div> <div class="paragraph"> <p>This is a channel-like interface to the actual connection, and allows you to read and write data as well as do various other things like close the stream.</p> </div> <div class="paragraph"> <p>A stream handler can be set on the server directly, the connection can still be obtained</p> </div> <div class="listingblock"> <div class="content"> <pre class="undefined highlight"><code data-lang="java"><span class="line"><span style="color:#d2a8e0">QuicServer</span><span style="color:#edf2f8"> server</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1"> =</span><span style="color:#edf2f8"> vertx</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">createQuicServer</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#edf2F8FF">sslOptions</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">)</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#edf2f8">server</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">streamHandler</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#edf2F8FF">stream </span><span style="color:#d2a8e0">-></span><span style="color:#adb5bd"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#68d391;font-style:italic">  // Handle streams here</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#d2a8e0">  QuicConnection</span><span style="color:#edf2f8"> connection</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1"> =</span><span style="color:#edf2f8"> stream</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">connection</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">()</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">})</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span></code></pre> </div> </div> </div> <div class="sect2"> <h3 id="_reading_data_from_a_stream"><a class="link" href="#_reading_data_from_a_stream">Reading data from a stream</a></h3> <div class="paragraph"> <p>To read data from the stream you set the <code><a href="../../apidocs/io/vertx/core/net/QuicStream.html#handler-io.vertx.core.Handler-">handler</a></code> on the stream.</p> </div> <div class="paragraph"> <p>This handler will be called with an instance of <code><a href="../../apidocs/io/vertx/core/buffer/Buffer.html">Buffer</a></code> every time data is received on the socket.</p> </div> <div class="listingblock"> <div class="content"> <pre class="undefined highlight"><code data-lang="java"><span class="line"><span style="color:#edf2f8">connection</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">streamHandler</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#edf2F8FF">stream </span><span style="color:#d2a8e0">-></span><span style="color:#adb5bd"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#edf2f8">  stream</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">handler</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#edf2F8FF">buffer </span><span style="color:#d2a8e0">-></span><span style="color:#adb5bd"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#edf2f8">    System</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#edf2f8">out</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">println</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">"</span><span style="color:#90cdf4">I received some bytes: </span><span style="color:#adb5bd">"</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1"> +</span><span style="color:#edf2f8"> buffer</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">length</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">())</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">  })</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">})</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span></code></pre> </div> </div> </div> <div class="sect2"> <h3 id="_writing_data_to_a_stream"><a class="link" href="#_writing_data_to_a_stream">Writing data to a stream</a></h3> <div class="paragraph"> <p>You write to a stream using one of <code><a href="../../apidocs/io/vertx/core/streams/WriteStream.html#write-java.lang.Object-">write</a></code>.</p> </div> <div class="listingblock"> <div class="content"> <pre class="undefined highlight"><code data-lang="java"><span class="line"><span style="color:#d2a8e0">Buffer</span><span style="color:#edf2f8"> buffer</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1"> =</span><span style="color:#edf2f8"> Buffer</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">buffer</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">().</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">appendFloat</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#90cdf4">12.34f</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">).</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">appendInt</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#90cdf4">123</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">)</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#edf2f8">stream</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">write</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#edf2F8FF">buffer</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">)</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#68d391;font-style:italic">// Write a string in UTF-8 encoding</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#edf2f8">stream</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">write</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">"</span><span style="color:#90cdf4">some data</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">"</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">)</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#68d391;font-style:italic">// Write a string using the specified encoding</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#edf2f8">stream</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">write</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">"</span><span style="color:#90cdf4">some data</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">"</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">,</span><span style="color:#adb5bd"> "</span><span style="color:#90cdf4">UTF-16</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">"</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">)</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span></code></pre> </div> </div> <div class="paragraph"> <p>Write operations are asynchronous and may not occur until some time after the call to write has returned.</p> </div> </div> <div class="sect2"> <h3 id="_streaming"><a class="link" href="#_streaming">Streaming</a></h3> <div class="paragraph"> <p>Instances of <code><a href="../../apidocs/io/vertx/core/net/QuicStream.html">QuicStream</a></code> are also <code><a href="../../apidocs/io/vertx/core/streams/ReadStream.html">ReadStream</a></code> and <code><a href="../../apidocs/io/vertx/core/streams/WriteStream.html">WriteStream</a></code> instances, so they can be used to pipe data to or from other read and write streams.</p> </div> <div class="paragraph"> <p>See the chapter on <a href="#streams">streams </a> for more information.</p> </div> </div> <div class="sect2"> <h3 id="_sending_files_or_resources_from_the_classpath_2"><a class="link" href="#_sending_files_or_resources_from_the_classpath_2">Sending files or resources from the classpath</a></h3> <div class="paragraph"> <p>Files and classpath resources can be written to the socket directly using <code><a href="../../apidocs/io/vertx/core/net/StreamChannel.html#sendFile-java.lang.String-">sendFile</a></code>.</p> </div> <div class="paragraph"> <p>Please see the chapter about <a href="#classpath">serving files from the classpath</a> for restrictions of the classpath resolution or disabling it.</p> </div> <div class="listingblock"> <div class="content"> <pre class="undefined highlight"><code data-lang="java"><span class="line"><span style="color:#edf2F8FF">stream</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">  .</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">sendFile</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">"</span><span style="color:#90cdf4">myfile.dat</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">"</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">  .</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">onSuccess</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#edf2F8FF">v </span><span style="color:#d2a8e0">-></span><span style="color:#edf2f8"> System</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#edf2f8">out</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">println</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">"</span><span style="color:#90cdf4">File successfully sent</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">"</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">))</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">  .</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">onFailure</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#edf2F8FF">err </span><span style="color:#d2a8e0">-></span><span style="color:#edf2f8"> System</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#edf2f8">out</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">println</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">"</span><span style="color:#90cdf4">Could not send file: </span><span style="color:#adb5bd">"</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1"> +</span><span style="color:#edf2f8"> err</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">getMessage</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">()))</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span></code></pre> </div> </div> </div> <div class="sect2"> <h3 id="_lifecycle_of_a_stream"><a class="link" href="#_lifecycle_of_a_stream">Lifecycle of a stream</a></h3> <div class="paragraph"> <p>Any side of a stream can cleanly terminate its output, signaling no more data will be emitted.</p> </div> <div class="listingblock"> <div class="content"> <pre class="undefined highlight"><code data-lang="java"><span class="line"><span style="color:#edf2f8">stream</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">end</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">()</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span></code></pre> </div> </div> <div class="paragraph"> <p>You can set an end handler to be notified when the opposite side has terminated its output.</p> </div> <div class="listingblock"> <div class="content"> <pre class="undefined highlight"><code data-lang="java"><span class="line"><span style="color:#edf2f8">stream</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">endHandler</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#edf2F8FF">v </span><span style="color:#d2a8e0">-></span><span style="color:#adb5bd"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#68d391;font-style:italic">  // Clean termination (received a STREAM frame with the FIN bit)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">})</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span></code></pre> </div> </div> <div class="paragraph"> <p>A stream is closed when output is shut down on both sides.</p> </div> <div class="paragraph"> <p>If you want to be notified when a stream is closed, you can set a <code><a href="../../apidocs/io/vertx/core/net/QuicStream.html#closeHandler-io.vertx.core.Handler-">closeHandler</a></code> on it:</p> </div> <div class="listingblock"> <div class="content"> <pre class="undefined highlight"><code data-lang="java"><span class="line"><span style="color:#edf2f8">stream</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">closeHandler</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#edf2F8FF">v </span><span style="color:#d2a8e0">-></span><span style="color:#adb5bd"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#edf2f8">  System</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#edf2f8">out</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">println</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">"</span><span style="color:#90cdf4">The stream has been closed</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">"</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">)</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">})</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span></code></pre> </div> </div> <div class="paragraph"> <p>Any side of a stream can abruptly terminate the stream, <code><a href="../../apidocs/io/vertx/core/net/QuicStream.html#reset-int-">reset</a></code> sends a reset frame signaling no more data will be emitted. Reset requires an error code argument used to convey application level error.</p> </div> <div class="listingblock"> <div class="content"> <pre class="undefined highlight"><code data-lang="java"><span class="line"><span style="color:#edf2f8">stream</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">reset</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#edf2F8FF">ERROR_CODE</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">)</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span></code></pre> </div> </div> <div class="paragraph"> <p>Likewise, <code><a href="../../apidocs/io/vertx/core/net/QuicStream.html#abort-int-">abort</a></code> instructs the other side that no more data should be emitted: aborting asks the other side to reset the stream with the provided code.</p> </div> <div class="listingblock"> <div class="content"> <pre class="undefined highlight"><code data-lang="java"><span class="line"><span style="color:#edf2f8">stream</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">abort</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#edf2F8FF">ERROR_CODE</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">)</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span></code></pre> </div> </div> <div class="paragraph"> <p>If you want to be notified when a stream is reset, you can set a <code><a href="../../apidocs/io/vertx/core/net/QuicStream.html#resetHandler-io.vertx.core.Handler-">resetHandler</a></code> on it:</p> </div> <div class="listingblock"> <div class="content"> <pre class="undefined highlight"><code data-lang="java"><span class="line"><span style="color:#edf2f8">stream</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">resetHandler</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#edf2F8FF">errorCode </span><span style="color:#d2a8e0">-></span><span style="color:#adb5bd"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#edf2f8">  System</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#edf2f8">out</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">println</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">"</span><span style="color:#90cdf4">The stream has been reset with error code </span><span style="color:#adb5bd">"</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1"> +</span><span style="color:#edf2F8FF"> errorCode</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">)</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">})</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span></code></pre> </div> </div> <div class="paragraph"> <p>You can set an <code><a href="../../apidocs/io/vertx/core/net/QuicStream.html#exceptionHandler-io.vertx.core.Handler-">exceptionHandler</a></code> to receive any exceptions that happen on the stream.</p> </div> </div> <div class="sect2"> <h3 id="_local_and_remote_addresses_2"><a class="link" href="#_local_and_remote_addresses_2">Local and remote addresses</a></h3> <div class="paragraph"> <p>The local address of a <code><a href="../../apidocs/io/vertx/core/net/QuicConnection.html">QuicConnection</a></code> can be retrieved using <code><a href="../../apidocs/io/vertx/core/net/QuicConnection.html#localAddress--">localAddress</a></code>.</p> </div> <div class="paragraph"> <p>The remote address, (i.e. the address of the other end of the connection) of a <code><a href="../../apidocs/io/vertx/core/net/QuicConnection.html">QuicConnection</a></code> can be retrieved using <code><a href="../../apidocs/io/vertx/core/net/QuicConnection.html#remoteAddress--">remoteAddress</a></code>.</p> </div> </div> <div class="sect2"> <h3 id="_quic_graceful_shut_down"><a class="link" href="#_quic_graceful_shut_down">QUIC graceful shut down</a></h3> <div class="paragraph"> <p>You can shut down a <code><a href="../../apidocs/io/vertx/core/net/QuicEndpoint.html#shutdown--">server</a></code> or <code><a href="../../apidocs/io/vertx/core/net/QuicEndpoint.html#shutdown--">client</a></code>.</p> </div> <div class="paragraph"> <p>Calling <code>shutdown</code> initiates the shut-down phase whereby the server or client are given the opportunity to perform clean-up actions and handle shutdown at the protocol level.</p> </div> <div class="listingblock"> <div class="content"> <pre class="undefined highlight"><code data-lang="java"><span class="line"><span style="color:#edf2F8FF">server</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">  .</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">shutdown</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">()</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">  .</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">onSuccess</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#edf2F8FF">res </span><span style="color:#d2a8e0">-></span><span style="color:#adb5bd"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#edf2f8">    System</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#edf2f8">out</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">println</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">"</span><span style="color:#90cdf4">Server is now closed</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">"</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">)</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">  })</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span></code></pre> </div> </div> <div class="paragraph"> <p>Shut-down waits until all connections/streams are closed or the shut-down timeout fires. When the timeout fires, all resources are forcibly closed.</p> </div> <div class="paragraph"> <p>Each opened connection and stream is notified with a shutdown event, allowing to perform a protocol level close before the actual close.</p> </div> <div class="listingblock"> <div class="content"> <pre class="undefined highlight"><code data-lang="java"><span class="line"><span style="color:#edf2f8">stream</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">shutdownHandler</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#edf2F8FF">v </span><span style="color:#d2a8e0">-></span><span style="color:#adb5bd"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#edf2F8FF">  stream</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#68d391;font-style:italic">    // Write close frame</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">    .</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">write</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">closeFrame</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">())</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#68d391;font-style:italic">    // Wait until we receive the remote close frame</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">    .</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">compose</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#edf2F8FF">success </span><span style="color:#d2a8e0">-></span><span style="color:#f7fafc"> closeFrameHandler</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#edf2F8FF">stream</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">))</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#68d391;font-style:italic">    // Close the socket</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">    .</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">eventually</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(()</span><span style="color:#d2a8e0"> -></span><span style="color:#edf2f8"> stream</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">close</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">())</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">})</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span></code></pre> </div> </div> <div class="paragraph"> <p>Any stream without a shutdown handler is closed immediately</p> </div> <div class="paragraph"> <p>The default shut-down timeout is 30 seconds, you can override the amount of time</p> </div> <div class="listingblock"> <div class="content"> <pre class="undefined highlight"><code data-lang="java"><span class="line"><span style="color:#edf2F8FF">server</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">  .</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">shutdown</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#edf2f8">Duration</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">ofSeconds</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#90cdf4">60</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">))</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">  .</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">onSuccess</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#edf2F8FF">res </span><span style="color:#d2a8e0">-></span><span style="color:#adb5bd"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#edf2f8">    System</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#edf2f8">out</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">println</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">"</span><span style="color:#90cdf4">Server is now closed</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">"</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">)</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">  })</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span></code></pre> </div> </div> <div class="paragraph"> <p>You can also shut down QUIC connection individually</p> </div> <div class="listingblock"> <div class="content"> <pre class="undefined highlight"><code data-lang="java"><span class="line"><span style="color:#edf2F8FF">server</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">  .</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">shutdown</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">()</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">  .</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">onSuccess</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#edf2F8FF">res </span><span style="color:#d2a8e0">-></span><span style="color:#adb5bd"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#edf2f8">    System</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#edf2f8">out</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">println</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">"</span><span style="color:#90cdf4">Connection is now closed</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">"</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">)</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">  })</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span></code></pre> </div> </div> </div> <div class="sect2"> <h3 id="_quic_close"><a class="link" href="#_quic_close">QUIC close</a></h3> <div class="paragraph"> <p>You can close a <code><a href="../../apidocs/io/vertx/core/net/QuicEndpoint.html#close--">server</a></code> or <code><a href="../../apidocs/io/vertx/core/net/QuicEndpoint.html#close--">client</a></code> to immediately close all open connections/streams and releases all resources. Unlike <code>shutdown</code> there is not grace period.</p> </div> <div class="paragraph"> <p>The close is actually asynchronous and might not complete until some time after the call has returned. You can use the returned future to be notified when the actual close has completed.</p> </div> <div class="paragraph"> <p>This future is completed when the close has fully completed.</p> </div> <div class="listingblock"> <div class="content"> <pre class="undefined highlight"><code data-lang="java"><span class="line"><span style="color:#edf2F8FF">server</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">  .</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">close</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">()</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">  .</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">onSuccess</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#edf2F8FF">res </span><span style="color:#d2a8e0">-></span><span style="color:#adb5bd"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#edf2f8">    System</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#edf2f8">out</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">println</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">"</span><span style="color:#90cdf4">Server is now closed</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">"</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">)</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">  })</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span></code></pre> </div> </div> </div> <div class="sect2"> <h3 id="_automatic_clean_up_in_verticles_4"><a class="link" href="#_automatic_clean_up_in_verticles_4">Automatic clean-up in verticles</a></h3> <div class="paragraph"> <p>If you&#8217;re creating QUIC servers and clients from inside verticles, those servers and clients will be automatically closed when the verticle is undeployed.</p> </div> </div> <div class="sect2"> <h3 id="_creating_a_quic_client"><a class="link" href="#_creating_a_quic_client">Creating a QUIC client</a></h3> <div class="paragraph"> <p>The simplest way to create a QUIC client, using all default options is as follows:</p> </div> <div class="listingblock"> <div class="content"> <pre class="undefined highlight"><code data-lang="java"><span class="line"><span style="color:#d2a8e0">ClientSSLOptions</span><span style="color:#edf2f8"> sslOptions</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1"> =</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1"> new</span><span style="color:#f7fafc"> ClientSSLOptions</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">()</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">  .</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">setTrustOptions</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">new</span><span style="color:#f7fafc"> JksOptions</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">().</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#f7fafc">    setPath</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">"</span><span style="color:#90cdf4">/path/to/your/truststore.jks</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">"</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">).</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#f7fafc">    setPassword</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">"</span><span style="color:#90cdf4">password-of-your-truststore</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">"</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">  )</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">  .</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">setApplicationLayerProtocols</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#edf2f8">List</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">of</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#edf2F8FF">APPLICATION_PROTOCOL</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">))</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#d2a8e0">QuicClient</span><span style="color:#edf2f8"> client</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1"> =</span><span style="color:#edf2f8"> vertx</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">createQuicClient</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#edf2F8FF">sslOptions</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">)</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span></code></pre> </div> </div> <div class="paragraph"> <p>QUIC mandates the usage of application layer protocol negotiation (ALPN) and therefore an application protocol should be set with <code><a href="../../apidocs/io/vertx/core/net/SSLOptions.html#setApplicationLayerProtocols-java.util.List-">setApplicationLayerProtocols</a></code>, without it, this client will not be capable of handshaking with any server.</p> </div> </div> <div class="sect2"> <h3 id="quic_client"><a class="link" href="#quic_client">Configuring a QUIC client</a></h3> <div class="paragraph"> <p>If you don&#8217;t want the default, a client can be configured by passing in a <code><a href="../../apidocs/io/vertx/core/net/QuicClientConfig.html">QuicClientConfig</a></code> instance when creating it:</p> </div> <div class="listingblock"> <div class="content"> <pre class="undefined highlight"><code data-lang="java"><span class="line"><span style="color:#d2a8e0">QuicClientConfig</span><span style="color:#edf2f8"> config</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1"> =</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1"> new</span><span style="color:#f7fafc"> QuicClientConfig</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">()</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">  .</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">setConnectTimeout</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#edf2f8">Duration</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">ofSeconds</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#90cdf4">10</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">))</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#d2a8e0">QuicClient</span><span style="color:#edf2f8"> client</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1"> =</span><span style="color:#edf2f8"> vertx</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">createQuicClient</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#edf2F8FF">config</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">,</span><span style="color:#edf2F8FF"> sslOptions</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">)</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span></code></pre> </div> </div> </div> <div class="sect2"> <h3 id="_making_connections_2"><a class="link" href="#_making_connections_2">Making connections</a></h3> <div class="paragraph"> <p>To make a connection to a server you use <code><a href="../../apidocs/io/vertx/core/net/QuicClient.html#connect-int-java.lang.String-">connect</a></code>, specifying the port and host of the server, returning a future completed with the <code><a href="../../apidocs/io/vertx/core/net/QuicConnection.html">QuicConnection</a></code></p> </div> <div class="listingblock"> <div class="content"> <pre class="undefined highlight"><code data-lang="java"><span class="line"><span style="color:#d2a8e0">QuicClientConfig</span><span style="color:#edf2f8"> options</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1"> =</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1"> new</span><span style="color:#f7fafc"> QuicClientConfig</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">()</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">  .</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">setConnectTimeout</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#edf2f8">Duration</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">ofSeconds</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#90cdf4">10</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">))</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#d2a8e0">QuicClient</span><span style="color:#edf2f8"> client</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1"> =</span><span style="color:#edf2f8"> vertx</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">createQuicClient</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#edf2F8FF">options</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">,</span><span style="color:#edf2F8FF"> sslOptions</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">)</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#edf2F8FF">client</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">  .</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">connect</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#90cdf4">4321</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">,</span><span style="color:#adb5bd"> "</span><span style="color:#90cdf4">localhost</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">"</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">  .</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">onComplete</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#edf2F8FF">res </span><span style="color:#d2a8e0">-></span><span style="color:#adb5bd"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#d2a8e1">    if</span><span style="color:#adb5bd"> (</span><span style="color:#edf2f8">res</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">succeeded</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">())</span><span style="color:#adb5bd"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#edf2f8">      System</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#edf2f8">out</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">println</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">"</span><span style="color:#90cdf4">Connected!</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">"</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">)</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#d2a8e0">      QuicConnection</span><span style="color:#edf2f8"> connection</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1"> =</span><span style="color:#edf2f8"> res</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">result</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">()</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">    }</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1"> else</span><span style="color:#adb5bd"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#edf2f8">      System</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#edf2f8">out</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">println</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">"</span><span style="color:#90cdf4">Failed to connect: </span><span style="color:#adb5bd">"</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1"> +</span><span style="color:#edf2f8"> res</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">cause</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">().</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">getMessage</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">())</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">    }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">  })</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span></code></pre> </div> </div> </div> <div class="sect2"> <h3 id="_configuring_connection_attempts_2"><a class="link" href="#_configuring_connection_attempts_2">Configuring connection attempts</a></h3> <div class="paragraph"> <p>A client can be configured to automatically retry connecting to the server in the event that it cannot connect. This is configured with <code><a href="../../apidocs/io/vertx/core/net/QuicClientConfig.html#setReconnectInterval-java.time.Duration-">setReconnectInterval</a></code> and <code><a href="../../apidocs/io/vertx/core/net/QuicClientConfig.html#setReconnectAttempts-int-">setReconnectAttempts</a></code>.</p> </div> <div class="admonitionblock note"> <table> <tr> <td class="icon"> <i class="fa icon-note" title="Note"></i> </td> <td class="content"> Currently, Vert.x will not attempt to reconnect if a connection fails, reconnect attempts and interval only apply to creating initial connections. </td> </tr> </table> </div> <div class="listingblock"> <div class="content"> <pre class="undefined highlight"><code data-lang="java"><span class="line"><span style="color:#d2a8e0">QuicClientConfig</span><span style="color:#edf2f8"> options</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1"> =</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1"> new</span><span style="color:#f7fafc"> QuicClientConfig</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">().</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#f7fafc">  setReconnectAttempts</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#90cdf4">10</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">).</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#f7fafc">  setReconnectInterval</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#edf2f8">Duration</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">ofMillis</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#90cdf4">500</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">))</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#d2a8e0">QuicClient</span><span style="color:#edf2f8"> client</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1"> =</span><span style="color:#edf2f8"> vertx</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">createQuicClient</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#edf2F8FF">options</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">,</span><span style="color:#edf2F8FF"> sslOptions</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">)</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span></code></pre> </div> </div> <div class="paragraph"> <p>By default, multiple connection attempts are disabled.</p> </div> </div> <div class="sect2"> <h3 id="_opening_streams"><a class="link" href="#_opening_streams">Opening streams</a></h3> <div class="paragraph"> <p>A QUIC connection multiplexes QUIC streams which is what your application actually interacts with.</p> </div> <div class="paragraph"> <p>To open a stream you use <code><a href="../../apidocs/io/vertx/core/net/QuicConnection.html#openStream--">openStream</a></code>, returning a future completed with the <code><a href="../../apidocs/io/vertx/core/net/QuicStream.html">QuicStream</a></code></p> </div> <div class="listingblock"> <div class="content"> <pre class="undefined highlight"><code data-lang="java"><span class="line"><span style="color:#edf2F8FF">connection</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">  .</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">openStream</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">()</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">  .</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">onComplete</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#edf2F8FF">res </span><span style="color:#d2a8e0">-></span><span style="color:#adb5bd"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#d2a8e1">    if</span><span style="color:#adb5bd"> (</span><span style="color:#edf2f8">res</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">succeeded</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">())</span><span style="color:#adb5bd"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#d2a8e0">      QuicStream</span><span style="color:#edf2f8"> stream</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1"> =</span><span style="color:#edf2f8"> res</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">result</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">()</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#edf2f8">      stream</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">write</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">"</span><span style="color:#90cdf4">hello</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">"</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">)</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">    }</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1"> else</span><span style="color:#adb5bd"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#edf2f8">      System</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#edf2f8">out</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">println</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">"</span><span style="color:#90cdf4">Failed to open: </span><span style="color:#adb5bd">"</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1"> +</span><span style="color:#edf2f8"> res</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">cause</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">().</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">getMessage</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">())</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">    }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">  })</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span></code></pre> </div> </div> <div class="admonitionblock warning"> <table> <tr> <td class="icon"> <i class="fa icon-warning" title="Warning"></i> </td> <td class="content"> Opening the stream only allocates it locally, the remote side of the connection is not aware of the presence of the stream until you actually send data. </td> </tr> </table> </div> <div class="paragraph"> <p>By default, the connection opens a bidirectional stream.</p> </div> <div class="paragraph"> <p>QUIC supports unidirectional streams too, you can open them as well when the remote side allows it.</p> </div> <div class="listingblock"> <div class="content"> <pre class="undefined highlight"><code data-lang="java"><span class="line"><span style="color:#edf2F8FF">connection</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">  .</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">openStream</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">false</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">  .</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">onComplete</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#edf2F8FF">res </span><span style="color:#d2a8e0">-></span><span style="color:#adb5bd"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#d2a8e1">    if</span><span style="color:#adb5bd"> (</span><span style="color:#edf2f8">res</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">succeeded</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">())</span><span style="color:#adb5bd"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#68d391;font-style:italic">      // Obtained a write-only streams</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#d2a8e0">      QuicStream</span><span style="color:#edf2f8"> stream</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1"> =</span><span style="color:#edf2f8"> res</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">result</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">()</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#edf2f8">      stream</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">write</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">"</span><span style="color:#90cdf4">hello</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">"</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">)</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">    }</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1"> else</span><span style="color:#adb5bd"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#edf2f8">      System</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#edf2f8">out</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">println</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">"</span><span style="color:#90cdf4">Failed to open: </span><span style="color:#adb5bd">"</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1"> +</span><span style="color:#edf2f8"> res</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">cause</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">().</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">getMessage</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">())</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">    }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">  })</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span></code></pre> </div> </div> </div> <div class="sect2"> <h3 id="quic_transport_configuration"><a class="link" href="#quic_transport_configuration">QUIC transport configuration</a></h3> <div class="paragraph"> <p>QUIC uses transport parameters to determine the connection behavior, e.g. the maximum number of streams an endpoint allows.</p> </div> <div class="paragraph"> <p><code><a href="../../apidocs/io/vertx/core/net/QuicConfig.html">QuicConfig</a></code> configures transport parameters, you should be aware of a few of them.</p> </div> <div class="paragraph"> <p>The following parameters are client/server sensitive and configure the limit per connection:</p> </div> <div class="ulist"> <ul> <li> <p><code>initial_max_streams_bidi</code>: the maximum number of bidirectional streams the endpoint can receive</p> </li> <li> <p><code>initial_max_streams_uni</code>: the maximum number of unidirectional streams the endpoint can receive</p> </li> <li> <p><code>initial_max_data</code>: the maximum number of bytes that can be sent on a connection</p> </li> <li> <p><code>initial_max_stream_data_bidi_local</code>: the flow control limit for locally initiated bidirectional streams</p> </li> <li> <p><code>initial_max_stream_data_bidi_remote</code>: the flow control limit for peer initiated bidirectional streams</p> </li> <li> <p><code>initial_max_stream_data_uni</code>: the flow control limit for unidirectional streams</p> </li> </ul> </div> <table class="tableblock frame-all grid-all stretch"> <colgroup> <col style="width:25%"> <col style="width:25%"> <col style="width:25%"> <col style="width:25%"> </colgroup> <thead> <tr> <th class="tableblock halign-left valign-top">parameter</th> <th class="tableblock halign-left valign-top">default value</th> <th class="tableblock halign-left valign-top">default client</th> <th class="tableblock halign-left valign-top">default server</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody> <tr> <td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">initial_max_streams_bidi</p></td> <td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">0</p></td> <td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">0</p></td> <td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">256</p></td> </tr> <tr> <td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">initial_max_streams_uni</p></td> <td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">0</p></td> <td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">0</p></td> <td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">0</p></td> </tr> <tr> <td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">initial_max_data</p></td> <td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">10_485_760</p></td> <td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">10_485_760</p></td> <td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">10_485_760</p></td> </tr> <tr> <td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">initial_max_stream_data_bidi_local</p></td> <td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">0</p></td> <td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">1_048_576</p></td> <td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">0</p></td> </tr> <tr> <td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">initial_max_stream_data_bidi_bemote</p></td> <td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">0</p></td> <td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">0</p></td> <td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">1_048_576</p></td> </tr> <tr> <td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">initial_max_stream_data_uni</p></td> <td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">0</p></td> <td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">0</p></td> <td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">0</p></td> </tr> </tbody> </table> <div class="paragraph"> <p>These default parameters model a traditional client / server in which the client opens bidirectional streams like TCP does.</p> </div> <div class="paragraph"> <p>Each protocol should define proper defaults, e.g. HTTP/3 relies on unidirectional streams and therefore configures a few parameters differently for this purpose.</p> </div> <div class="paragraph"> <p>Vert.x HTTP/3 provides sensitive QUIC transport configuration as well.</p> </div> </div> <div class="sect2"> <h3 id="_quic_datagram_extension"><a class="link" href="#_quic_datagram_extension">QUIC datagram extension</a></h3> <div class="paragraph"> <p>You can configure your endpoint to support the <a href="https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc9221">QUIC Datagram Extension</a>.</p> </div> <div class="listingblock"> <div class="content"> <pre class="undefined highlight"><code data-lang="java"><span class="line"><span style="color:#edf2F8FF">endpointConfig</span></span>
