<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">  .</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">setDatagramConfig</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">new</span><span style="color:#f7fafc"> QuicDatagramConfig</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">()</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">    .</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">setEnabled</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">true</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">))</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span></code></pre> </div> </div> <div class="paragraph"> <p>Once your endpoint is started, you should check the extension is available.</p> </div> <div class="listingblock"> <div class="content"> <pre class="undefined highlight"><code data-lang="java"><span class="line"><span style="color:#d2a8e1">long</span><span style="color:#edf2f8"> maxLength</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1"> =</span><span style="color:#edf2f8"> connection</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">maxDatagramLength</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">()</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#d2a8e1">if</span><span style="color:#adb5bd"> (</span><span style="color:#edf2F8FF">maxLength </span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">></span><span style="color:#90cdf4"> 0</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">)</span><span style="color:#adb5bd"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#edf2f8">  connection</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">datagramHandler</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#edf2F8FF">dgram </span><span style="color:#d2a8e0">-></span><span style="color:#adb5bd"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#edf2f8">    connection</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">writeDatagram</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#edf2F8FF">dgram</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">)</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">  })</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">}</span></span></code></pre> </div> </div> </div> <div class="sect2"> <h3 id="quic_client_address_validation"><a class="link" href="#quic_client_address_validation">QUIC client address validation</a></h3> <div class="paragraph"> <p>QUIC is based on UDP and can be subject to <a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/learning/ddos/dns-amplification-ddos-attack/">amplification attacks</a>.</p> </div> <div class="paragraph"> <p>Address validations ensures that a QUIC server cannot be used for such attacks.</p> </div> <div class="paragraph"> <p>By default, Vert.x performs basic address validation, but this is not sufficient for production.</p> </div> <div class="paragraph"> <p>We recommend configuring address validation based on cryptographic key instead for production.</p> </div> <div class="listingblock"> <div class="content"> <pre class="undefined highlight"><code data-lang="java"><span class="line"><span style="color:#d2a8e0">QuicServerConfig</span><span style="color:#edf2f8"> config</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1"> =</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1"> new</span><span style="color:#f7fafc"> QuicServerConfig</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">()</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">  .</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">setClientAddressValidation</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#edf2f8">QuicClientAddressValidation</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#edf2f8">CRYPTO</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">  .</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">setClientAddressValidationKey</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">new</span><span style="color:#f7fafc"> JksOptions</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">()</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">    .</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">setPath</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">"</span><span style="color:#90cdf4">/path/to/your/key.jks</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">"</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">    .</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">setPassword</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">"</span><span style="color:#90cdf4">wibble</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">"</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">  )</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span></code></pre> </div> </div> <div class="paragraph"> <p>Depending on the nature of the key, either symmetric (MAC) or asymmetric (Digital Signature) is achieved.</p> </div> <div class="paragraph"> <p>The following signing algorithms are supported:</p> </div> <div class="ulist"> <ul> <li> <p>HS256: HmacSHA256/HmacSHA384/HmacSHA512</p> </li> <li> <p>RSA: SHA256withRSA/SHA384withRSA/SHA512withRSA</p> </li> <li> <p>ECDSA: SHA256withECDSA/SHA384withECDSA/SHA512withECDSA</p> </li> </ul> </div> <div class="paragraph"> <p>By default, a validation token is valid for 30 seconds, you can configure also configure it.</p> </div> <div class="listingblock"> <div class="content"> <pre class="undefined highlight"><code data-lang="java"><span class="line"><span style="color:#d2a8e0">QuicServerConfig</span><span style="color:#edf2f8"> config</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1"> =</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1"> new</span><span style="color:#f7fafc"> QuicServerConfig</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">()</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">  .</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">setClientAddressValidation</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#edf2f8">QuicClientAddressValidation</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#edf2f8">CRYPTO</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">  .</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">setClientAddressValidationKey</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#edf2F8FF">key</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">  .</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">setClientAddressValidationTimeWindow</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#edf2f8">Duration</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">ofSeconds</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#90cdf4">15</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">))</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span></code></pre> </div> </div> </div> <div class="sect2"> <h3 id="quic_logging_network_activity"><a class="link" href="#quic_logging_network_activity">Logging network activity</a></h3> <div class="paragraph"> <p>For debugging purposes, stream network activity can be logged:</p> </div> <div class="listingblock"> <div class="content"> <pre class="undefined highlight"><code data-lang="java"><span class="line"><span style="color:#d2a8e0">QuicServerConfig</span><span style="color:#edf2f8"> options</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1"> =</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1"> new</span><span style="color:#f7fafc"> QuicServerConfig</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">()</span></span>

When using network activity logging there are a few things to keep in mind:</p> </div> <div class="ulist"> <ul> <li> <p>logging is not performed by Vert.x logging but by Netty</p> </li> <li> <p>this is <strong>not</strong> a production feature</p> </li> </ul> </div> <div class="paragraph"> <p>You should read the <a href="#netty-logging">Netty logging</a> section.</p> </div> </div> <div class="sect2"> <h3 id="_qlog_configuration"><a class="link" href="#_qlog_configuration">QLog configuration</a></h3> <div class="paragraph"> <p>Vert.x QUIC implementation is based on Netty and <a href="https://github.com/cloudflare/quiche">QUICHE</a>, a savoury implementation of QUIC.</p> </div> <div class="paragraph"> <p>QUICHE logs in the <a href="https://www.ietf.org/archive/id/draft-ietf-quic-qlog-main-schema-13.html">QLog</a> JSON-SEQ format, QUICHE output is file based. It is configured independently of your JVM logging.</p> </div> <div class="paragraph"> <p>You can use <code><a href="../../apidocs/io/vertx/core/net/QLogConfig.html">QLogConfig</a></code> to configure QLog.</p> </div> <div class="listingblock"> <div class="content"> <pre class="undefined highlight"><code data-lang="java"><span class="line"><span style="color:#d2a8e0">QuicServerConfig</span><span style="color:#edf2f8"> cfg</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1"> =</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1"> new</span><span style="color:#f7fafc"> QuicServerConfig</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">()</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">  .</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">setQLogConfig</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">new</span><span style="color:#f7fafc"> QLogConfig</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">()</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">    .</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">setPath</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">"</span><span style="color:#90cdf4">/path/to/log/dir/</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">"</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">    .</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">setTitle</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">"</span><span style="color:#90cdf4">Server logging</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">"</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">    .</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">setDescription</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">"</span><span style="color:#90cdf4">Logging of QUIC server</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">"</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">))</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span></code></pre> </div> </div> <div class="paragraph"> <p>The logging granularity is per connection, that is, each connection will be logged in its own file.</p> </div> <div class="admonitionblock caution"> <table> <tr> <td class="icon"> <i class="fa icon-caution" title="Caution"></i> </td> <td class="content"> this should not be used in production, only for the purpose of logging QUICHE </td> </tr> </table> </div> </div> <div class="sect2"> <h3 id="_configuring_ssltls"><a class="link" href="#_configuring_ssltls">Configuring SSL/TLS</a></h3> <div class="sect3"> <h4 id="_configuring_ssltls_per_connection"><a class="link" href="#_configuring_ssltls_per_connection">Configuring SSL/TLS per connection</a></h4> <div class="paragraph"> <p>The client performs an SSL/TLS handshake with the client provided SSL configuration.</p> </div> <div class="paragraph"> <p>You can perform a fine-grained per connection configuration</p> </div> <div class="listingblock"> <div class="content"> <pre class="undefined highlight"><code data-lang="java"><span class="line"><span style="color:#d2a8e0">ClientSSLOptions</span><span style="color:#edf2f8"> sslOptions</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1"> =</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1"> new</span><span style="color:#f7fafc"> ClientSSLOptions</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">()</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">  .</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">setTrustOptions</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">new</span><span style="color:#f7fafc"> JksOptions</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">().</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#f7fafc">    setPath</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">"</span><span style="color:#90cdf4">/path/to/your/truststore.jks</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">"</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">).</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#f7fafc">    setPassword</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">"</span><span style="color:#90cdf4">password-of-your-truststore</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">"</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">  )</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">  .</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">setApplicationLayerProtocols</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#edf2f8">List</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">of</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#edf2F8FF">APPLICATION_PROTOCOL</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">))</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#d2a8e0">Future</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">&#x3C;</span><span style="color:#d2a8e0">QuicConnection</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">></span><span style="color:#edf2f8"> future</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1"> =</span><span style="color:#edf2f8"> client</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">connect</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#edf2F8FF">  port</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#edf2F8FF">  host</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#d2a8e1">  new</span><span style="color:#f7fafc"> QuicConnectOptions</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">().</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">setSslOptions</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#edf2F8FF">sslOptions</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">)</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span></code></pre> </div> </div> </div> <div class="sect3"> <h4 id="_client_host_verification_2"><a class="link" href="#_client_host_verification_2">Client host verification</a></h4> <div class="paragraph"> <p>By default, host verification is <strong>not</strong> configured on the client. This verifies the CN portion of the server certificate against the server hostname to avoid <a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Man-in-the-middle_attack">Man-in-the-middle attacks</a>.</p> </div> <div class="paragraph"> <p>You must configure it explicitly on your client</p> </div> <div class="ulist"> <ul> <li> <p><code>""</code> (empty string) disables host verification</p> </li> <li> <p><code>"HTTPS"</code> enables HTTP over TLS <a href="https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc2818#section-3.1">verification</a></p> </li> <li> <p><code>LDAPS</code> enables LDAP v3 extension for TLS <a href="https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc2830#section-3.6">verification</a></p> </li> </ul> </div> <div class="listingblock"> <div class="content"> <pre class="undefined highlight"><code data-lang="java"><span class="line"><span style="color:#d2a8e0">ClientSSLOptions</span><span style="color:#edf2f8"> sslOptions</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1"> =</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1"> new</span><span style="color:#f7fafc"> ClientSSLOptions</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">()</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">  .</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">setTrustOptions</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#edf2F8FF">trustOptions</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">  .</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">setApplicationLayerProtocols</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#edf2f8">List</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">of</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#edf2F8FF">APPLICATION_PROTOCOL</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">))</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">  .</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">setHostnameVerificationAlgorithm</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#edf2F8FF">verificationAlgorithm</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">)</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span></code></pre> </div> </div> <div class="admonitionblock note"> <table> <tr> <td class="icon"> <i class="fa icon-note" title="Note"></i> </td> <td class="content"> the Vert.x HTTP client uses the QUIC client and configures with <code>"HTTPS"</code> the verification algorithm. </td> </tr> </table> </div> </div> <div class="sect3"> <h4 id="_updating_ssltls_configuration_2"><a class="link" href="#_updating_ssltls_configuration_2">Updating SSL/TLS configuration</a></h4> <div class="paragraph"> <p>You can use the <code>updateSSLOptions</code> method to update the key/certifications or trust on a QUIC server or client (e.g. to implement certificate rotation).</p> </div> <div class="listingblock"> <div class="content"> <pre class="undefined highlight"><code data-lang="java"><span class="line"><span style="color:#d2a8e0">Future</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">&#x3C;</span><span style="color:#d2a8e0">Boolean</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">></span><span style="color:#edf2f8"> fut</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1"> =</span><span style="color:#edf2f8"> server</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">updateSSLOptions</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">new</span><span style="color:#f7fafc"> ServerSSLOptions</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">()</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#d2a8e1">    new</span><span style="color:#f7fafc"> JksOptions</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">()</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">      .</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">setPath</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">"</span><span style="color:#90cdf4">/path/to/your/server-keystore.jks</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">"</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">).</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#f7fafc">      setPassword</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">"</span><span style="color:#90cdf4">password-of-your-keystore</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">"</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">))</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">  .</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">setApplicationLayerProtocols</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#edf2f8">List</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">of</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#edf2F8FF">APPLICATION_PROTOCOL</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">)))</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span></code></pre> </div> </div> <div class="paragraph"> <p>When the update succeeds the new SSL configuration is used, otherwise the previous configuration is preserved.</p> </div> <div class="admonitionblock note"> <table> <tr> <td class="icon"> <i class="fa icon-note" title="Note"></i> </td> <td class="content"> The options object is compared (using <code>equals</code>) against the existing options to prevent an update when the objects are equals since loading options can be costly. When object are equals, you can use the <code>force</code> parameter to force the update. </td> </tr> </table> </div> </div> <div class="sect3"> <h4 id="_ssltls_key_logging"><a class="link" href="#_ssltls_key_logging">SSL/TLS key logging</a></h4> <div class="paragraph"> <p>QUICHE relies on BoringSSL and supports SSL/TLS key logging.</p> </div> <div class="listingblock"> <div class="content"> <pre class="undefined highlight"><code data-lang="java"><span class="line"><span style="color:#d2a8e0">QuicServerConfig</span><span style="color:#edf2f8"> serverCfg</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1"> =</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1"> new</span><span style="color:#f7fafc"> QuicServerConfig</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">()</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">  .</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">setClientAddressValidation</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#edf2f8">QuicClientAddressValidation</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#edf2f8">NONE</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">  .</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">setKeyLogFile</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">"</span><span style="color:#90cdf4">/path/to/keylogfile.txt</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">"</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">)</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span></code></pre> </div> </div> <div class="admonitionblock note"> <table> <tr> <td class="icon"> <i class="fa icon-note" title="Note"></i> </td> <td class="content"> this requires to disable client address validation to work properly. </td> </tr> </table> </div> <div class="paragraph"> <p>When configured, BoringSSL logs keys for decrypting SSL/TLS in the configured log, which can be then used by tools such as Wireshark to decrypt QUIC traffic.</p> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> <div class="sect1"> <h2 id="_writing_http_servers_and_clients"><a class="link" href="#_writing_http_servers_and_clients">Writing HTTP servers and clients</a></h2> <div class="sectionbody"> <div class="paragraph"> <p>Vert.x allows you to easily write non-blocking HTTP clients and servers.</p> </div> <div class="paragraph"> <p>Vert.x supports the HTTP/1.0, HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2 and HTTP/3 protocols.</p> </div> <div class="paragraph"> <p>The base API for HTTP is the same for HTTP/1.x, HTTP/2 and HTTP/3, specific API features are available for dealing with the protocol peculiarities.</p> </div> <div class="sect2"> <h3 id="_creating_an_http_server"><a class="link" href="#_creating_an_http_server">Creating an HTTP Server</a></h3> <div class="paragraph"> <p>The simplest way to create an HTTP server, using default config is as follows:</p> </div> <div class="listingblock"> <div class="content"> <pre class="undefined highlight"><code vertx</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">createHttpServer</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">()</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span></code></pre> </div> </div> <div class="paragraph"> <p>By default, the server supports HTTP/1, HTTP/2 in plain text and WebSocket</p> </div> </div> <div class="sect2"> <h3 id="_configuring_an_http_server"><a class="link" <span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">    .</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">addGzip</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">())</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#d2a8e0">HttpServer</span><span style="color:#edf2f8"> server</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1"> =</span><span style="color:#edf2f8"> vertx</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">createHttpServer</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#edf2F8FF">config</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">)</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span></code></pre> </div> </div> <div class="paragraph"> <p>Configuration addresses the following parts:</p> </div> <div class="ulist"> <ul> <li> <p>Accepted versions</p> </li> <li> <p>Timeouts and limits</p> </li> <li> <p>HTTP/1.x specific configuration</p> </li> <li> <p>HTTP/2 specific configuration</p> </li> <li> <p>HTTP/3 specific configuration</p> </li> <li> <p>WebSocket</p> </li> <li> <p>TLS</p> </li> <li> <p>Transport: TCP and QUIC</p> </li> <li> <p>Content compression</p> </li> <li> <p>Observability</p> </li> <li> <p>Network logging</p> </li> </ul> </div> </div> <div class="sect2"> <h3 id="_configuring_an_https_server"><a class="link" href="#_configuring_an_https_server">Configuring an HTTPS server</a></h3> <div class="paragraph"> <p>Vert.x HTTP servers can be configured to use HTTPS in exactly the same way as TCP or QUIC servers.</p> </div> <div class="listingblock"> <div class="content"> <pre class="undefined highlight"><code data-lang="java"><span class="line"><span style="color:#d2a8e0">ServerSSLOptions</span><span style="color:#edf2f8"> sslOptions</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1"> =</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1"> new</span><span style="color:#f7fafc"> ServerSSLOptions</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">()</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">  .</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">setHttp1Config</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">new</span><span style="color:#f7fafc"> Http1ServerConfig</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">()</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">    .</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">setMaxInitialLineLength</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#90cdf4">1024</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">))</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span></code></pre> </div> </div> <div class="paragraph"> <p><code><a href="../../apidocs/io/vertx/core/http/Http1ServerConfig.html">Http1ServerConfig</a></code> captures the configuration of HTTP/1.x specific aspects.</p> </div> </div> <div class="sect2"> <h3 id="_configuring_an_http2_server"><a class="link" href="#_configuring_an_http2_server">Configuring an HTTP/2 server</a></h3> <div class="paragraph"> <p>Vert.x supports HTTP/2 over TLS <code>h2</code> and over TCP <code>h2c</code>.</p> </div> <div class="ulist"> <ul> <li> <p><code>h2</code> identifies the HTTP/2 protocol when used over TLS</p> </li> <li> <p><code>h2c</code> identifies the HTTP/2 protocol when using in clear text over TCP, such connections are established either with an HTTP/1.1 upgraded request or directly</p> </li> </ul> </div> <div class="paragraph"> <p>To handle <code>h2</code> requests, TLS must be enabled:</p> </div> <div class="listingblock"> <div class="content"> <pre class="undefined highlight"><code data-lang="java"><span class="line"><span style="color:#d2a8e0">HttpServerConfig</span><span style="color:#edf2f8"> config</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1"> =</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1"> new</span><span style="color:#f7fafc"> HttpServerConfig</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">()</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">  .</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">setHttp2Config</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">new</span><span style="color:#f7fafc"> Http2ServerConfig</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">()</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">    .</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">setInitialSettings</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">new</span><span style="color:#f7fafc"> Http2Settings</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">()</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">      .</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">setMaxConcurrentStreams</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#90cdf4">250</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">)))</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span></code></pre> </div> </div> <div class="paragraph"> <p>With plain text (TLS is disabled), the server handles <code>h2c</code> requests that wants to upgrade connections presenting an HTTP/1.1 upgrade request to HTTP/2. It also accepts direct <code>h2c</code> (with prior knowledge) connections beginning with the <code>PRI * HTTP/2.0\r\nSM\r\n</code> preface.</p> </div> <div class="admonitionblock warning"> <table> <tr> <td class="icon"> <i class="fa icon-warning" title="Warning"></i> </td> <td class="content"> browsers do not support <code>h2c</code>, for serving websites you should use <code>h2</code> and not <code>h2c</code>. </td> </tr> </table> </div> <div class="paragraph"> <p><code><a href="../../apidocs/io/vertx/core/http/Http2ServerConfig.html">Http2ServerConfig</a></code> captures the configuration of HTTP/2 specific aspects.</p> </div> <div class="paragraph"> <p>When a server accepts an HTTP/2 connection, it sends to the client its <code><a href="../../apidocs/io/vertx/core/http/Http2ServerConfig.html#getInitialSettings--">initial settings</a></code>. These settings define how the client can use the connection, the default initial settings for a server are:</p> </div> <div class="ulist"> <ul> <li> <p><code><a href="../../apidocs/io/vertx/core/http/Http2Settings.html#getMaxConcurrentStreams--">getMaxConcurrentStreams</a></code>: <code>100</code> as recommended by the HTTP/2 RFC</p> </li> <li> <p><code><a href="../../apidocs/io/vertx/core/http/Http2Settings.html#getInitialWindowSize--">getInitialWindowSize</a></code>: <code>1 MiB</code></p> </li> <li> <p>the default HTTP/2 settings values for the remaining settings</p> </li> </ul> </div> <div class="paragraph"> <p>HTTP/2 flow control uses two independent receive windows. The initial window size in <code><a href="../../apidocs/io/vertx/core/http/Http2ServerConfig.html#getInitialSettings--">getInitialSettings</a></code> applies to each stream, while <code><a href="../../apidocs/io/vertx/core/http/Http2ServerConfig.html#getConnectionWindowSize--">getConnectionWindowSize</a></code> applies to the combined data received by all streams on a connection. The connection window defaults to <code>16 MiB</code>.</p> </div> <div class="paragraph"> <p>Applications receiving large request bodies, such as large gRPC messages, can tune both values. Larger windows improve throughput on connections with significant bandwidth or latency, at the cost of allowing more data to be buffered before back-pressure is applied.</p> </div> </div> <div class="sect2"> <h3 id="_configuring_an_http3_server"><a class="link" href="#_configuring_an_http3_server">Configuring an HTTP/3 server</a></h3> <div class="paragraph"> <p>Vert.x supports HTTP/3 over QUIC, we recommend reading the <a href="#quic_server">QUIC server section</a>.</p> </div> <div class="paragraph"> <p>QUIC is new transport layer for HTTP that replaces TCP and has TLS built-in, in fact TLS is mandatory.</p> </div> <div class="paragraph"> <p>The implementation of QUIC relies on Netty and <a href="https://github.com/cloudflare/quiche">QUICHE</a>, a savoury implementation of QUIC which requires native dependencies depending on OS/platform selection, you can learn more about running <a href="#native_quic">native QUIC</a>.</p> </div> <div class="listingblock"> <div class="content"> <pre class="undefined highlight"><code data-lang="java"><span class="line"><span style="color:#d2a8e0">HttpServerConfig</span><span style="color:#edf2f8"> config</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1"> =</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1"> new</span><span style="color:#f7fafc"> HttpServerConfig</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">()</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">  .</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">setVersions</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#edf2f8">HttpVersion</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#edf2f8">HTTP_3</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">)</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span></code></pre> </div> </div> <div class="paragraph"> <p><code><a href="../../apidocs/io/vertx/core/http/Http3ServerConfig.html">Http3ServerConfig</a></code> captures the configuration of HTTP/3 specific aspects.</p> </div> <div class="paragraph"> <p>QUIC implements some of the features of HTTP/2, such as the maximum number of concurrent streams a connection can handle:</p> </div> <div class="listingblock"> <div class="content"> <pre class="undefined highlight"><code data-lang="java"><span class="line"><span style="color:#d2a8e0">HttpServerConfig</span><span style="color:#edf2f8"> config</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1"> =</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1"> new</span><span style="color:#f7fafc"> HttpServerConfig</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">()</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">  .</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">setVersions</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#edf2f8">HttpVersion</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#edf2f8">HTTP_3</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">)</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#d2a8e0">QuicServerConfig</span><span style="color:#edf2f8"> quicConfig</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1"> =</span><span style="color:#edf2f8"> config</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">getQuicConfig</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">()</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#edf2f8">quicConfig</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">setTransportConfig</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">new</span><span style="color:#f7fafc"> QuicConfig</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">()</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">  .</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">setInitialMaxStreamsBidi</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#90cdf4">250</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">))</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span></code></pre> </div> </div> <div class="paragraph"> <p>QUIC servers can be subject to <a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/learning/ddos/dns-amplification-ddos-attack/">amplification attacks</a>.</p> </div> <div class="paragraph"> <p>By default, a server is configured with a basic token validation which works well for development purpose, we recommend configuring token validation based on <a href="#quic_client_address_validation">cryptography</a> instead.</p> </div> </div> <div class="sect2"> <h3 id="_hybrid_http_server"><a class="link" href="#_hybrid_http_server">Hybrid HTTP server</a></h3> <div class="paragraph"> <p>A server can handle both TCP (HTTP/1.x and HTTP/2) and QUIC (HTTP/3).</p> </div> <div class="listingblock"> <div class="content"> <pre class="undefined highlight"><code data-lang="java"><span class="line"><span style="color:#d2a8e0">HttpServerConfig</span><span style="color:#edf2f8"> config</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1"> =</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1"> new</span><span style="color:#f7fafc"> HttpServerConfig</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">()</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">  .</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">setVersions</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#edf2f8">HttpVersion</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#edf2f8">HTTP_1_1</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">,</span><span style="color:#edf2f8"> HttpVersion</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#edf2f8">HTTP_2</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">,</span><span style="color:#edf2f8"> HttpVersion</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#edf2f8">HTTP_3</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">)</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#d2a8e0">ServerSSLOptions</span><span style="color:#edf2f8"> sslOptions</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1"> =</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1"> new</span><span style="color:#f7fafc"> ServerSSLOptions</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">()</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">  .</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">setKeyCertOptions</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">new</span><span style="color:#f7fafc"> JksOptions</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">().</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">setPath</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">"</span><span style="color:#90cdf4">/path/to/my/keystore</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">"</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">))</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#d2a8e0">HttpServer</span><span style="color:#edf2f8"> server</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1"> =</span><span style="color:#edf2f8"> vertx</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">createHttpServer</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#edf2F8FF">config</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">,</span><span style="color:#edf2F8FF"> sslOptions</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">)</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span></code></pre> </div> </div> <div class="paragraph"> <p>Hybrid servers bind two ports</p> </div> <div class="ulist"> <ul> <li> <p>a TCP port serving HTTP/1.x and/or HTTP/2 traffic</p> </li> <li> <p>a QUIC port (UDP) serving HTTP/3 traffic</p> </li> </ul> </div> <div class="paragraph"> <p>Each port can be configured independently</p> </div> <div class="listingblock"> <div class="content"> <pre class="undefined highlight"><code data-lang="java"><span class="line"><span style="color:#d2a8e0">HttpServerConfig</span><span style="color:#edf2f8"> config</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1"> =</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1"> new</span><span style="color:#f7fafc"> HttpServerConfig</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">()</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">  .</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">setVersions</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#edf2f8">HttpVersion</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#edf2f8">HTTP_1_1</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">,</span><span style="color:#edf2f8"> HttpVersion</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#edf2f8">HTTP_2</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">,</span><span style="color:#edf2f8"> HttpVersion</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">.</span><span style="color:#edf2f8">HTTP_3</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">)</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">  .</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">setQuicPort</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#edf2F8FF">quicPort</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">)</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span></code></pre> </div> </div> <div class="paragraph"> <p>Or can be the same (TCP and UDP ports are distinct)</p> </div> <div class="listingblock"> <div class="content"> <pre class="undefined highlight"><code data-lang="java"><span class="line"><span style="color:#d2a8e0">HttpServerConfig</span><span style="color:#edf2f8"> config</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1"> =</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1"> new</span><span style="color:#f7fafc"> HttpServerConfig</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">()</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#adb5bd">  .</span><span style="color:#f7fafc">setPort</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">(</span><span style="color:#edf2F8FF">port</span><span style="color:#adb5bd">)</span><span style="color:#d2a8e1">;</span></span></code></pre> </div> </div> <div class="paragraph"> <p>Unless DNS configuration relies on HTTPS resource records to the HTTP/3 endpoint, the recommended way an HTTP server can advertise an HTTP/3 endpoint is to emit an <a href="https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7838">HTTP Alternative Services</a> notification.</p> </div> <div class="listingblock"> <div class="content"> <pre class="undefined highlight"><code data-lang="java"><span class="line"><span style="color:#edf2f8">response</span><span
